# RenderFrost SMP

> RenderFrost SMP is a whitelisted Minecraft Java survival server built on trust, fairness, creativity and respect. This site holds the official rules, the player list, community screenshots and the joining process.

## Key facts

- Server address: play.renderfrost.com (Minecraft Java Edition)
- Type: whitelisted survival multiplayer (SMP); PvP is off by default and only by mutual consent
- Joining: join the Discord, ask a staff member, complete verification and wait for approval
- Eligibility note: a 15-day recommendation rule applies to new players (see rule 19)
- Discord: https://discord.gg/SMRS6skKYY
- Whitelisted players listed on the website: 42
- Owner: SAGEKRAVE
- Manager: SfsNotHere
- Chief Staff: BS_Editz
- Dev/Admin: Tasfiq
